/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import sqlite3

original_balance = 100
for delivery in range(2):
    original_balance -= 50
assert original_balance == 0
print('\\''Original commit/redelivery schedule: two debits, total 100.'\\'')

db = sqlite3.connect('\\'':memory:'\\'', isolation_level=None)
db.executescript(\"\"\"
CREATE TABLE orders (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, balance INTEGER NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO orders VALUES ('\\''o-9'\\'', 100);
CREATE TABLE inbox (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE outbox (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL);
\"\"\")

def consume(message_id, order_id, amount, fail=False):
    db.execute('\\''BEGIN'\\'')
    try:
        inserted = db.execute('\\''INSERT INTO inbox VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING'\\'',
                              (message_id, order_id, amount)).rowcount
        if inserted:
            db.execute('\\''UPDATE orders SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ?'\\'', (amount, order_id))
            if fail:
                raise RuntimeError('\\''injected crash before transaction commit'\\'')
            db.execute(\"INSERT INTO outbox VALUES (?, ?, '\\''pending'\\'')\", (message_id, order_id))
        elif db.execute('\\''SELECT order_id, amount FROM inbox WHERE id = ?'\\'', (message_id,)).fetchone() "'!= (order_id, amount):
            raise ValueError('"'\\''identity reused with different intent'\\'')
        db.execute('\\''COMMIT'\\'')
    except BaseException:
        db.execute('\\''ROLLBACK'\\'')
        raise

consume('\\''m-7'\\'', '\\''o-9'\\'', 50)
consume('\\''m-7'\\'', '\\''o-9'\\'', 50)
assert db.execute('\\''SELECT balance FROM orders'\\'').fetchone()[0] == 50
assert db.execute('\\''SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox'\\'').fetchone()[0] == 1
assert db.execute('\\''SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox'\\'').fetchone()[0] == 1
print('\\''Corrected commit/redelivery schedule: one debit of 50, one pending notification.'\\'')

try:
    consume('\\''m-8'\\'', '\\''o-9'\\'', 10, fail=True)
except RuntimeError:
    pass
assert db.execute('\\''SELECT balance FROM orders'\\'').fetchone()[0] == 50
assert db.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox WHERE id = '\\''m-8'\\''\").fetchone()[0] == 0
print('\\''Failure before commit: claim and debit both rolled back.'\\'')

try:
    consume('\\''m-7'\\'', '\\''o-9'\\'', 60)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('\\''changed intent was accepted'\\'')
print('\\''Same identity with changed intent: rejected without another debit.'\\'')

provider_acceptances = []
provider_acceptances.append('\\''m-7'\\'')
assert db.execute(\"SELECT status FROM outbox WHERE id = '\\''m-7'\\''\").fetchone()[0] == '\\''pending'\\''
provider_acceptances.append('\\''m-7'\\'')
db.execute(\"UPDATE outbox SET status = '\\''accepted'\\'' WHERE id = '\\''m-7'\\''\")
assert len(provider_acceptances) == 2
assert db.execute('\\''SELECT balance FROM orders'\\'').fetchone()[0] == 50
print('\\''Provider-accepted/crash/retry schedule: two email acceptances are possible; debit remains once.'\\'')
print('\\''SQLite in-memory state-machine checks only; no actual broker or provider was exercised.'\\'')
